target_customer: Outpatient physical therapy and rehab practice groups
problem: Rehab clinics lose patients between inquiry and visit because calls, referrals, insurance verification and prior authorizations are slow. Shasta's AI agents run that front office work.
business_model: B2B SaaS and AI agent service sold to rehab practices
product_category: AI patient access agents for healthcare

founders.name: Srinjoy Majumdar
founders.background_notes: Undergraduate researcher at two healthcare robotics labs per YC page.

founders.name: Pransu Dash
founders.background_notes: Telehealth privacy research at UC Berkeley per YC page; no degree listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: At founding the product was computer vision guided physical therapy. The current version needs voice agents, EMR integrations and insurance workflows with HIPAA compliance.

defensibility.rationale: EMR and billing integrations help retention, but many AI front office vendors target healthcare and PT software vendors can add similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established PT software vendors market front office and intake tools, but no dated source shows them copying or buying Shasta.

market_need_then: Rehab practices handle high volumes of calls, referrals and prior authorizations. No dated source with spend or complaint data was found, so need is supported only by the company's own product description.

branding.domain_note: Uses shasta.health, a health TLD, rather than a .com.

identity.visual_style: Clean and modern healthcare look, with a brand kit page on the site
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and outcome focused, for example Answering the patient is only the beginning

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press or community was found. The name is neutral and unrelated to rehab, and the company has described itself in several ways.

pivots.from: At-home muscle and joint pain care combining computer vision programs with physical therapists, per older YC copy
pivots.to: AI agents for rehab practice front office work
pivots.why: Not stated; inferred from conflicting descriptions across sources, so date unknown

outcome_analysis: Shasta Health joined Summer 2023 and has moved from an at-home physical therapy concept toward AI agents for rehab practice front offices, now listing named PT practice customers. Funding is not confirmed beyond aggregator entries, and no acquisition, shutdown or layoff report was found. The story is early and unresolved, with no clear success or failure factor supported by sources.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators say about $500K pre-seed from Y Combinator dated August or September 2023, with no press release, so no round is recorded. Descriptions conflict across sources between in-home PT, helping therapists go independent and AI front office agents. The pivot date is unknown. Competitor search returned current PT software vendors with undated pages, so the dated list is empty.
